**Reading, per label** (from the verdicts, by the rule in docs/schedulers.md; it describes the validators of the label that we reached):

- Agave: consistent with reward per requested cost, the requested loaded-data limit included, with a base-fee share between 0.12 and 0.84 (the deployed source uses 0.5).
- JitoLabs: consistent with reward per requested cost, the requested loaded-data limit included, with a base-fee share between 0.12 and 0.84 (the deployed source uses 0.5).
- Firedancer: consistent with reward per requested cost, the requested loaded-data limit included, with a base-fee share between 0.12 and 0.84 (the deployed source uses 0.5).
- Rakurai: consistent with reward per requested cost, the requested loaded-data limit included, with a base-fee share between 0.12 and 0.84 (the deployed source uses 0.5).

- A,E before C: same cost, strictly higher fee: every fee-aware rule agrees (positive control).
- A,E before F: same price, fee and CU limit; F requests a 64 MiB loaded-data limit: only a cost that includes the requested loaded-data limit puts A and E first.
- C before B: reward/cost with a base-fee share k > 0.12 puts C first; prio fee/cost, price and total fee put B first.
- D before C: reward/cost with k < 0.84 puts D first; the whole base fee (k = 1) or cost alone would put C first.
- A before B: every per-unit rule puts A first; total fee puts B first.

## Confirmatory run (campaign "confirm"; pre-registered in docs/CONFIRM.md, git tag prereg-confirm)

New buffered/shared trials aimed at three of the four validators whose main-run trials departed from the reward/cost order ("Deviations from the reward/cost order, validator by validator"; the fourth, 7cVfgArC, has had no leader slots since epoch 1070), planned and tagged before the first of them. Two tests, Holm-adjusted together: H1 one-sided against chance by its exact null distribution, like the primary contrasts; H2 by the exact lower binomial tail against the reference rate. Fewer than 10 trials: insufficient data; otherwise confirmed when the Holm p < 0.05, else not confirmed. These trials appear only in this section, the run list and orders.md.

| hypothesis | validators | measure | trials | share [95% interval] | p | Holm p | verdict |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---|
| H1: orders by total fee | JitoLabs EvnRmnMr, C8Bey3LK | B before C (by chance 50%) | 30 | 97% [90%–100%] | <0.001 | <0.001 | **confirmed** |
| H2: departs from the exact reward/cost order | Firedancer JD549Hsb | trials with all six in the exact reward/cost order (reference 80%) | 20 | 70% [48%–85%] | 0.196 | 0.196 | **not confirmed** |

Per validator (descriptive). B before C: of the trials with both in the window.

| client | validator | versions | QUIC port | trials | trials with all six | exact reward/cost | exact total fee | other orders | B before C | kept by the sensitivity filter |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|
| JitoLabs | EvnRmnMr | 4.3.2 | 11228 | 15 | 15 | 0 | 15 | – | 15 of 15 | 0 |
| JitoLabs | C8Bey3LK | 4.3.2 | 8022 | 15 | 15 | 0 | 14 | DEACFB ×1 | 14 of 15 | 15 |
| Firedancer | JD549Hsb | 26.10.4 | 9007 | 20 | 20 | 14 | 0 | AEDBFC ×3, AEDCBF ×1, AEDFBC ×1, EADBFC ×1 | 5 of 20 | 20 |

Sensitivity (descriptive; the filter of the primary, unadjusted p): H1 93% of 15, p=<0.001; H2 70% of 20, p=0.196.

Delivery: 53 trials dispatched, 312 of 318 transactions landed, 50 trials with B, C, D, F and A or E in the window, 50 trials used.

## How far the total-fee reading goes (exploratory)

Added after both runs, outside both plans. **The order of the six.** B D, then A, E, F, C is also what "the larger requested compute-unit limit first, the larger fee between equal limits" predicts (40 000, 6 000, then 1 000 for the other four; `test/design.test.ts`), so these orders do not separate that rule from total fee.

**Ties.** A, E and F pay the same total fee. In the trials in the exact total-fee order (main + confirm): where F landed among the three, the chance of F first at least that often if the three tie at random (exact binomial, 1/3; chosen after seeing the data), and how many of the pairs among the three landed in send order.

## Targeted run (campaigns "rakurai" and "rakurai-swap"; pre-registered in docs/RAKURAI.md, git tag prereg-rakurai)

New buffered/shared trials, planned and tagged before the first of them. H1: the holders of an enabled Rakurai activation account among new JitoLabs validators put B before C more than matched JitoLabs validators without one (per validator the share of its trials with B before C, for validators with at least 5 such trials; exact one-sided permutation test of the difference of group means over validators; fewer than 3 validators in either group: insufficient data). H2: with B paying 10 000 lamports for 1 000 CU and D 9 000 for 40 000, C8Bey3LK puts B before D. H3: at the matched validators, which report Jito 4.4.0, the twin sent first lands first. H2 and H3: one-sided exact binomial against chance; fewer than 10 trials: insufficient data. All three Holm-adjusted together; confirmed when the Holm p < 0.05, else not confirmed. These trials appear only in this section, the run list, "Reported client over time" and orders.md.

No trials of the targeted campaigns yet.
